text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"A ranking of customers by beverage revenue, including customer name, beverage order count, and beverage product variety, using the certified top beverage customers block.","measures":[{"ref":"block:commerce.top_beverage_customers"}],"groupBy":[],"display":[],"filters":[],"expectedShape":"ranking","unresolved":[{"clause":"the bevereage catogery","options":[],"material":false}],"provenance":{"block:commerce.top_beverage_customers":"inherited"},"reply":"The top beverage customers block already scopes to beverage items only (is_drink_item = true), so all rows shown are beverage-category results; there isn't a separate 'category' column to add beyond the block's columns (customer_name, beverage_revenue, beverage_orders, beverage_product_types)."}
